verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page explicitly advertises customizable fields and workflows, with global and project-level configuration, and a community user confirms it offers a good amount of customization. A complaint about Jira's limited-transitions model is a design critique, not evidence that customization fails. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on defining custom fields and workflow statuses (the evidence is marketing taglines only), explicit mention of custom statuses as distinct from workflows, hands-on corroboration of configuring workflow statuses.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process

citations.quote: Scale processes and save time with customizable workflows that integrate with your tech stack.
